sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: glucosinolate-rich brassica profile. Kale brings a brassica-specific phytochemical angle beyond its vitamin bars. Has a more specific food identity. There is a reason it earns attention beyond the basic role. Leafy volume with very low calorie pressure. It adds a lot of plate volume without much energy load.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Cons next: freshness and prep can matter. Older or badly prepared kale can turn tough and bitter fast. Raw texture can be a barrier. The chewy texture can make it harder to enjoy raw than softer greens. Strong leafy flavour is not for everyone. It is nutrient-dense, but some people just do not like the bitter leafy taste.
